name: reliancebank
description: Reliance Bank — full-stack banking platform simulation

scripts.verify: pnpm check:voice && pnpm check:routes && turbo run lint typecheck test:cov build
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && pnpm db:wait
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm db:up
scripts.demo: pnpm db:up && pnpm build --filter=@reliance/api && pnpm demo:reset && turbo run dev
scripts.db:wait: until docker exec rb-mongo mongosh --port ${MONGO_PORT:-27317} --quiet --eval 'quit(db.runCommand({hello:1}).isWritablePrimary ? 0 : 1)' >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
